title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer May Not Use PS5's New QSSR Upscaler
description: Exploring discussions around Sony's new QSSR upscaler on base PS5 hardware and whether it might feature in GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Discussion Surrounding GTA 6 and Sony's QSSR Upscaler

As Sony recently introduced its new QSSR (Q-Scalable Super Resolution) upscaler—bringing a version of the PS5 Pro's acclaimed PSSR technology to base PS5 hardware—the gaming community has begun speculating about its potential integration into upcoming blockbuster titles, most notably Rockstar Games' highly anticipated *GTA 6*.

According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, this advanced upscaler has currently been incorporated into select first-party titles, specifically *Marvel’s Wolverine* and *Ghost of Yotei*. Furthermore, Sony has confirmed that the technology will eventually be made available to third-party developers. This timing has led to widespread speculation among industry observers that the introduction of QSSR could be strategically aligned with the broader launch and promotional window of *GTA 6*.

## Technical Realities on Base PS5 Hardware

Despite high hopes from fans wishing to see cutting-edge upscaling utilized in *GTA 6*, the reality of third-party game development and hardware integration remains complex. Given the massive scale, intricate physics, and immense graphical fidelity of the game, running it smoothly on base PS5 hardware will undoubtedly require significant optimization. While adopting a tool like QSSR could theoretically assist developers in hitting performance targets, the technology is still in its early stages of rollout for non-first-party studios.

Consequently, industry analysts and media commentary suggest that we may not necessarily see QSSR implemented in the immediate launch materials or initial versions of *GTA 6*. As this remains a subject of speculation and industry discussion, players will have to wait for official technical breakdowns from Rockstar Games to understand how the title performs across different hardware tiers.

## Editor's Take

Sony rolling out QSSR to base hardware is an exciting step for console optimization, but a project of *GTA 6*'s scale operates on its own unique technical timeline. Whether or not Rockstar chooses to utilize this specific upscaler, pushing the base PS5 to its absolute limits is guaranteed. We will keep a close eye on any future official updates regarding the game's technical specs.
